sentences.en: I'm Jenna Fisher.
sentences.zh: 我是珍娜·费舍尔。

sentences.en: And I'm Angela Kinsey.
sentences.zh: 我是安吉拉·金赛。

sentences.en: We were on The Office together.
sentences.zh: 我们曾一起出演《办公室》。

sentences.en: And we're best friends.
sentences.zh: 我们还是最好的朋友。

sentences.en: And now we're doing the ultimate Office Lovers podcast just for you.
sentences.zh: 现在，我们专为你带来终极的《办公室》粉丝播客。

sentences.en: Each week, we will dive deeper into the world of The Office with exclusive interviews,
sentences.zh: 每周，我们都会通过独家采访深入探索《办公室》的世界，

sentences.en: behind-the-scenes details, and lots of VFF stories.
sentences.zh: 分享幕后细节，还有许多我们这对挚友的故事。

sentences.en: We're The Office Lady 6.0.
sentences.zh: 我们是《办公室女士》6.0版。

sentences.en: Hi there, everybody.
sentences.zh: 大家好。

sentences.en: Bonjour.
sentences.zh: Bonjour（法语：你好）。

sentences.en: Why French?
sentences.zh: 为什么说法语？

sentences.en: Why French today?
sentences.zh: 今天为什么要说法语？

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: I'm wearing a black and white stripy sweater.
sentences.zh: 我穿着一件黑白条纹毛衣。

sentences.en: And I just feel like if I had a red beret, I'd be very French right now.
sentences.zh: 我感觉如果我戴上一顶红色贝雷帽，我现在就会非常有法国风情。

sentences.en: You would.
sentences.zh: 确实会。

sentences.en: Well, I couldn't wear my beret and my headphones to podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我没法既戴着贝雷帽又戴着耳机录播客。

sentences.en: True.
sentences.zh: 也是。

sentences.en: Before we get into this episode, I mean, are you dying to hear a jumping up and down update?
sentences.zh: 在进入本集内容之前，我是说，你是不是迫不及待想听听关于“蹦跳”的最新进展了？

sentences.en: Did you do your 50 jumps?
sentences.zh: 你每天都跳50下了吗？

sentences.en: Every day.
sentences.zh: 每天都跳。

sentences.en: I'm doing them every day.
sentences.zh: 我每天都在坚持。

sentences.en: My calves don't hurt anymore.
sentences.zh: 我的小腿已经不疼了。

sentences.en: Really?
sentences.zh: 真的吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 真的。

sentences.en: That was just the first couple of days.
sentences.zh: 那只是头几天的事。

sentences.en: And I think there's something to this.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这确实有点门道。

sentences.en: It's really great.
sentences.zh: 真的很棒。

sentences.en: I have a question for you.
sentences.zh: 我有个问题想问你。

sentences.en: What?
sentences.zh: 什么？

sentences.en: Are you jumping in sneakers or barefoot?
sentences.zh: 你是穿着运动鞋跳还是光脚跳？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不。

sentences.en: Not in sneakers.
sentences.zh: 不穿运动鞋。

sentences.en: So here's what I do.
sentences.zh: 我是这样做的。

sentences.en: I get up in the morning.
sentences.zh: 我早上起床。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: I shower or get dressed.
sentences.zh: 洗个澡或者穿好衣服。

sentences.en: I mean, I have to put something on the ladies, some form of support before I start jumping.
sentences.zh: 我是说，在开始跳之前，我得给胸部穿点什么，提供某种支撑。

sentences.en: Right, so they don't bounce like crazy.
sentences.zh: 对，这样它们就不会疯狂晃动了。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And then I jump.
sentences.zh: 然后我就开始跳。

sentences.en: And then I go downstairs and I get my cup of coffee and I get my morning started.
sentences.zh: 跳完我就下楼去喝杯咖啡，开启我的一天。

sentences.en: But it's like very first thing and I'm usually, Sam, what is it?
sentences.zh: 但这真的是我做的第一件事，我通常……山姆，那是多少来着？

sentences.en: How high are you jumping?
sentences.zh: 你跳得有多高？

sentences.en: Not high.
sentences.zh: 不高。

sentences.en: You don't have to jump high.
sentences.zh: 你不需要跳得很高。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: I'm picturing you doing like basketball style, like leaps.
sentences.zh: 我脑补了一下你像打篮球那样跳跃的样子。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: No, imagine like enough for a jump rope to fit under my feet, but I'm not bending my knees.
sentences.zh: 不，想象一下，高度刚好能让跳绳从我脚下穿过，但我膝盖不弯曲。

sentences.en: I'm just jumping up.
sentences.zh: 我只是向上跳。

sentences.en: And, but then I also like, I wave my arms because I just like want my arms to be part of the pumping
sentences.zh: 而且，我还喜欢挥动双臂，因为我希望我的手臂也能参与到这种律动中，

sentences.en: of the jumping.
sentences.zh: 参与到跳跃中。

sentences.en: Perfect.
sentences.zh: 完美。

sentences.en: What day are you on?
sentences.zh: 你坚持多少天了？

sentences.en: How many days?
sentences.zh: 多少天了？

sentences.en: Maybe like 10 now or something.
sentences.zh: 大概10天了吧，或者差不多。

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我也不确定。

sentences.en: I need to look and see when I started.
sentences.zh: 我得去查查我是什么时候开始的。

sentences.en: You got to mark that down.
sentences.zh: 你得记下来。

sentences.en: This is where my mind goes is that, um, cause my house is this older house, right?
sentences.zh: 我脑子里想的是，嗯，因为我的房子是那种老房子，对吧？

sentences.en: That if our kids jump upstairs in the kitchen, we're like, what was that?
sentences.zh: 如果孩子们在楼上厨房跳，我们就会想，那是什么声音？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: I mean, it's so loud.
sentences.zh: 我是说，声音太大了。

sentences.en: So I, I sort of picture Lee making coffee in the morning and like ding, ding, ding, ding, ding.
sentences.zh: 所以我脑补了一下李早上在楼下冲咖啡，然后听到叮、叮、叮、叮、叮的声音。

sentences.en: They didn't mention anything.
sentences.zh: 他们什么都没提。

sentences.en: I had to tell them I was doing the jumping.
sentences.zh: 我不得不告诉他们我在跳绳。

sentences.en: No one said, mom, what's happening up there every morning now?
sentences.zh: 没人问过我，妈，现在每天早上楼上在干嘛？

sentences.en: Well, you probably have better insulation than we have.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你们家的隔音可能比我们家好。

sentences.en: Maybe.
sentences.zh: 也许吧。

sentences.en: I mean, you could drop a quarter upstairs and we're like, oh, someone dropped something.
sentences.zh: 我是说，你在楼上掉个硬币，我们都能听到，心想，哦，有人掉东西了。

sentences.en: Are you still patting yourself down, Angela?
sentences.zh: 安吉拉，你还在坚持拍打自己吗？

sentences.en: I don't do it every day.
sentences.zh: 我不是每天都做。

sentences.en: I don't know why that's funny to me.
sentences.zh: 我不知道为什么这让我觉得很好笑。

sentences.en: Because it's predictable.
sentences.zh: 因为这很符合你的性格。

sentences.en: The most predictable thing about me is my inconsistency with the new trend.
sentences.zh: 关于我最符合性格的事，就是我对新潮流总是三分钟热度。

sentences.en: The only thing I'm stuck with is tennis.
sentences.zh: 我唯一坚持下来的就是打网球。

sentences.en: Like I do tennis every week.
sentences.zh: 我每周都打网球。

sentences.en: That's all I got.
sentences.zh: 我就只有这个坚持下来了。

sentences.en: Well, listen, why don't we jump into this episode today?
sentences.zh: 好吧，听着，我们为什么不直接进入今天这集呢？

sentences.en: We are going to break down the super fan of customer survey.
sentences.zh: 我们要来解析《客户调查》这一集。

sentences.en: Customer survey was season five, episode seven.
sentences.zh: 《客户调查》是第五季第七集。

sentences.en: It was written by Lester Lewis and directed by Stephen Merchant.
sentences.zh: 由莱斯特·刘易斯编剧，斯蒂芬·莫昌特执导。

sentences.en: We've got a version of Fast Facts for you, friends.
sentences.zh: 朋友们，我们为你们准备了一个特别版的“快速事实”。

sentences.en: It's called Where Are They Now?
sentences.zh: 它叫“他们现在在哪里？”

sentences.en: That's what it's called.
sentences.zh: 就叫这个名字。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Fast Fact number one is called Where Are They Now?
sentences.zh: 第一个快速事实叫“他们现在在哪里？”

sentences.en: Character recap.
sentences.zh: 角色回顾。

sentences.en: Cassie helped us with this.
sentences.zh: 卡西帮了我们不少忙。

sentences.en: We thought it might be good to frame where are we now in everyone's storyline.
sentences.zh: 我们觉得梳理一下每个人的故事线进展到哪儿了会很有意义。

sentences.en: So, last episode, the episode prior to customer survey, Michael and Daryl drop Holly off at Nashua.
sentences.zh: 所以，上一集，也就是《客户调查》之前的那一集，迈克尔和达里尔把霍莉送到了纳舒厄。

sentences.en: This is after David Wallace caught Michael and Holly kissing at the Crime Aid fundraiser and said they can no longer work together.
sentences.zh: 这是在大卫·华莱士在“犯罪援助”募捐会上抓到迈克尔和霍莉接吻，并说他们不能再一起工作之后发生的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: So, he transfers Holly.
sentences.zh: 所以，他把霍莉调走了。

sentences.en: That was such a dick move, David Wallace.
sentences.zh: 大卫·华莱士那招真是太混蛋了。

sentences.en: I agree.
sentences.zh: 我同意。

sentences.en: How many people are hooking up in this office over the years?
sentences.zh: 这些年来，办公室里到底有多少人在搞暧昧？

sentences.en: Seriously.
sentences.zh: 说真的。

sentences.en: So many.
sentences.zh: 太多了。

sentences.en: Angela Martin would have been transferred a long time ago.
sentences.zh: 安吉拉·马丁早该被调走了。

sentences.en: I know.
sentences.zh: 我知道。

sentences.en: Well, Holly doesn't think that a long-distance relationship is going to work and ends things with Michael.
sentences.zh: 嗯，霍莉觉得异地恋行不通，于是和迈克尔分手了。

sentences.en: It's very sad.
sentences.zh: 这太令人难过了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: Pam is in New York.
sentences.zh: 帕姆在纽约。

sentences.en: She is attending art school and now also working at the corporate offices of Dunder Mifflin.
sentences.zh: 她正在上艺术学校，现在也在邓德·米夫林的总公司工作。

sentences.en: She and Jim are engaged.
sentences.zh: 她和吉姆订婚了。

sentences.en: Angela Martin is engaged to Andy and Andy is very excitedly planning their wedding.
sentences.zh: 安吉拉·马丁和安迪订婚了，安迪正兴致勃勃地筹备他们的婚礼。

sentences.en: But Angela is also having a secret affair with Dwight that Phyllis got a glimpse of back in season four finale Goodbye, Toby.
sentences.zh: 但安吉拉还和德怀特保持着地下情，菲利斯在第四季大结局《再见，托比》中瞥见过一眼。

sentences.en: So, there's a lot happening here.
sentences.zh: 所以，这里发生了很多事。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: And finally, Ryan is back working at Dunder Mifflin and he's sort of seeing Kelly and his reluctant, aloof dating style.
sentences.zh: 最后，瑞安回到了邓德·米夫林工作，他正和凯莉约会，带着他那种勉强又冷漠的约会风格。

sentences.en: So, you guys, this episode originally aired on November 6, 2008.
sentences.zh: 所以，各位，这一集最初是在2008年11月6日播出的。

sentences.en: And Jenna thought it would be fun if we did a little thing called, Where Were We?
sentences.zh: 珍娜觉得如果我们做一个叫“我们当时在哪？”的小环节会很有趣。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Where Were We?
sentences.zh: 我们当时在哪？

sentences.en: Our fast fact, too, is called, Where Were We?
sentences.zh: 我们的速记事实环节也叫“我们当时在哪？”

sentences.en: Where Were We as Jenna and Angela?
sentences.zh: 作为珍娜和安吉拉，我们当时在哪？

sentences.en: Angela, do you want to tell us where you were?
sentences.zh: 安吉拉，你想告诉我们你当时在哪吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 好啊。

sentences.en: I went into my digital clutter, like you know I like to do.
sentences.zh: 我翻了翻我的数字杂物，就像你知道我喜欢做的那样。

sentences.en: And I have emails for you.
sentences.zh: 我有一些邮件要分享给你们。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: That I'm going to share.
sentences.zh: 我要分享出来。

sentences.en: The first one is, me and you and Jen Salata, writer, director Jen Salata, had a thread going.
sentences.zh: 第一封邮件是我们俩和编剧兼导演简·萨拉塔之间的往来邮件。

sentences.en: We did?
sentences.zh: 我们有吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 有的。

sentences.en: The week this episode came out, in fact, Jen emailed us and said, You guys, this is what I was talking about on set.
sentences.zh: 就在这一集播出的那周，简发邮件给我们说：“伙计们，这就是我在片场提到的那个。”

sentences.en: Have you seen this?
sentences.zh: 你们看过这个吗？

sentences.en: And it's titled, Ninja Cat.
sentences.zh: 标题是《忍者猫》。

sentences.en: What?
sentences.zh: 什么？

sentences.en: And I wrote, LOL, so awesome.
sentences.zh: 我回道：“哈哈，太棒了。”

sentences.en: And you wrote, ha, ha, ha, ha, ha, ha, ha.
sentences.zh: 你回道：“哈哈哈哈哈哈哈。”

sentences.en: And I went to the video and it's now unavailable.
sentences.zh: 我点开视频，结果现在已经看不了了。

sentences.en: Oh, no.
sentences.zh: 噢，不。

sentences.en: It was, clearly has, I mean, if titled correctly, is some sort of cat doing ninja moves?
sentences.zh: 显然，我是说，如果标题没起错的话，是不是某种猫在做忍者动作？

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: Ninja moves.
sentences.zh: 忍者动作。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: But a glimpse into what we talk about on set, by the way.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一下，这让我们得以一窥我们在片场都在聊些什么。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Also this week, we got an email from Randy Cordray.
sentences.zh: 这周我们还收到了一封来自兰迪·科德雷的邮件。

sentences.en: Aw, I just love even saying his name because I just adore him.
sentences.zh: 噢，我光是念他的名字就很开心，因为我太喜欢他了。

sentences.en: The email is titled, Office Latest Schedule.
sentences.zh: 邮件标题是《办公室最新时间表》。

sentences.en: And he addressed it, Hi, team office.
sentences.zh: 他称呼我们为“办公室团队，你们好”。

sentences.en: Please see the attached schedule.
sentences.zh: 请查看附件中的时间表。

sentences.en: It is now our plan to only shoot the Super Bowl two-parter in December.
sentences.zh: 我们现在的计划是只在十二月拍摄超级碗的两集特别篇。

sentences.en: We will shut down production for Thanksgiving from Monday, November 17th through Friday, December 12th.
sentences.zh: 我们将从11月17日星期一到12月12日星期五暂停感恩节期间的制作工作。

sentences.en: We're also going to have a table read on Wednesday, December 3rd.
sentences.zh: 我们还打算在12月3日星期三进行一次剧本围读。

sentences.en: Oh.
sentences.zh: 哦。

sentences.en: I know.
sentences.zh: 我知道。

sentences.en: And then he sent us a whole schedule, which you would have loved.
sentences.zh: 然后他给我们发了一整份时间表，你肯定会喜欢的。

sentences.en: And it said who was writing what episode and what director they had picked.
sentences.zh: 上面写了谁负责写哪一集，以及他们选定的导演是谁。

sentences.en: I would love that.
sentences.zh: 我会很喜欢的。

sentences.en: I know.
sentences.zh: 我知道。

sentences.en: And then lastly, I have one where I sent you a picture of Isabel being super cute.
sentences.zh: 最后，我还有一条信息，是我给你发了一张伊莎贝尔超级可爱的照片。

sentences.en: And you sent back a picture of yourself in a Dallas Cowboys jersey in front of wallpaper that you'd put in your bathroom.
sentences.zh: 然后你回了一张你穿着达拉斯牛仔队球衣的照片，背景是你贴在浴室里的壁纸。

sentences.en: And the wallpaper was all these different.
sentences.zh: 那壁纸上全是各种各样的……

sentences.en: It looked like bugs, maybe?
sentences.zh: 看起来像是虫子，对吧？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So in our old house, we wallpapered our bathroom with the pages of this book that was like, it was like illustrations of bugs and insects and snakes and things.
sentences.zh: 在我们以前的房子里，我们用这本书的页面贴了浴室的墙，书里全是虫子、昆虫、蛇之类的插图。

sentences.en: But it was really cool looking.
sentences.zh: 但看起来真的很酷。

sentences.en: Oh, we thought this was like the coolest thing.
sentences.zh: 哦，我们当时觉得这简直酷毙了。

sentences.en: Well, you look adorable in this picture.
sentences.zh: 嗯，照片里的你看起来很可爱。

sentences.en: Well, thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: I was trying to figure out if it was an early selfie or if you like set the phone down.
sentences.zh: 我一直在琢磨这到底是早期的自拍，还是你把手机架在那儿拍的。

sentences.en: Oh, yeah.
sentences.zh: 哦，对。

sentences.en: Clearly you took it, but it's super cute.
sentences.zh: 显然是你自己拍的，但真的超级可爱。

sentences.en: Well, there you go.
sentences.zh: 好吧，就是这样。

sentences.en: That's what you and I were doing in my digital clutter.
sentences.zh: 这就是你和我当时在我的数字杂物里做的事情。

sentences.en: We were getting emails from Randy with schedules.
sentences.zh: 我们收到了兰迪发来的时间表邮件。

sentences.en: We were looking at ninja cats and wallpaper and cute babies.
sentences.zh: 我们看了忍者猫、壁纸和可爱的宝宝。

sentences.en: I love your digital clutter.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢你的数字杂物。

sentences.en: That brought back such great memories.
sentences.zh: 那勾起了很多美好的回忆。

sentences.en: I know, but don't you want to find Ninja Cat now?
sentences.zh: 我知道，但你现在不想找到那只忍者猫吗？

sentences.en: I do.
sentences.zh: 我想。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: Well, I did a little deep dive and I found that in November of 2008, I attended a special screening of the movie Milk in New York.
sentences.zh: 我稍微深入挖掘了一下，发现2008年11月，我在纽约参加了电影《米尔克》的特别放映会。

sentences.en: Oh.
sentences.zh: 哦。

sentences.en: And I found pictures of it and I was reminded of how incredibly proud I was of this outfit that I put together for myself.
sentences.zh: 我找到了当时的照片，想起我当时对自己搭配的这套行头有多么自豪。

sentences.en: I styled myself for this screening.
sentences.zh: 那次放映会是我自己做的造型。

sentences.en: Oh, I can't wait.
sentences.zh: 哦，我等不及要看了。

sentences.en: What was your big showstopper fashion accessory?
sentences.zh: 你那套造型的压轴时尚单品是什么？

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: So, it was all black.
sentences.zh: 全身都是黑色的。

sentences.en: It was black pants.
sentences.zh: 穿的是黑裤子。

sentences.zh: 我真的很享受重温这一集。

sentences.en: I did too.
sentences.zh: 我也是。

sentences.en: And you guys, we hope you have a great week.
sentences.zh: 各位，希望你们这周过得愉快。

sentences.en: Thank you for listening, and we'll see you next time.
sentences.zh: 感谢收听，我们下次见。

sentences.en: Have a good one.
sentences.zh: 祝你们过得愉快。

sentences.en: Thank you for listening to Office Ladies.
sentences.zh: 感谢收听《办公室女士》。

sentences.en: Office Ladies is a presentation of Odyssey and is produced by Jenna Fisher and Angela Kinsey.
sentences.zh: 《办公室女士》由Odyssey出品，由珍娜·费舍尔和安吉拉·金赛制作。

sentences.en: Our executive producer is Cassie Jerkins.
sentences.zh: 我们的执行制片人是凯西·杰金斯。

sentences.en: Our audio engineer is Sam Kiefer, and our associate producer is Ainsley Bubaco.
sentences.zh: 我们的音频工程师是萨姆·基弗，助理制片人是安斯利·布巴科。

sentences.en: Odyssey's executive producer is Leah Reese Dennis.
sentences.zh: Odyssey的执行制片人是莉亚·里斯·丹尼斯。

sentences.en: Office Ladies was mixed and mastered by Bill Schultz.
sentences.zh: 《办公室女士》由比尔·舒尔茨进行混音和母带处理。

sentences.en: Our theme song is Rubber Tree by Creed Bratton.
sentences.zh: 我们的主题曲是克里德·布拉顿演唱的《橡胶树》。
